st_themaster_1a1.en: Come on, place your bets! Which school will challenge the Dragon Warriors?… No one?
st_themaster_1a1.zh: 快放马过来！哪个门派敢挑战龙战士？……没人敢？

st_themaster_1a3.en: You? You do not belong to any school. I will not fight you!
st_themaster_1a3.zh: 就凭你？你哪个门派都不是。我不会和你打！

st_themaster_1a4.en: 2 to 1 that I will defeat you… easily.
st_themaster_1a4.zh: 二对一，击败你小菜一碟。

st_themaster_1a5.en: …Alright. I will show you the true power of kung fu.
st_themaster_1a5.zh: ……好吧。我让你见识一下功夫的厉害。

st_themaster_1b1.en: Mmmm. You have talent, but your style is messy and without structure.
st_themaster_1b1.zh: 有点本事，但你的招式混乱，一点章法都没有。

st_themaster_1b2.en: You should come by the temple and talk to our Master.
st_themaster_1b2.zh: 你应该到寺庙来，向我们的师父讨教。

st_themaster_1b3.zh: 也许吧。但你得先把钱给我。

st_themaster_2a2.en: So you’re a master of Kung Fu.

st_themaster_2a3.en: I'm no master. I'm just a guide for my students.
st_themaster_2a3.zh: 我不是大师，我只是指导一下徒弟。

st_themaster_2a5.en: For their own truth, young one.
st_themaster_2a5.zh: 让他们认识真我，年轻人。

st_themaster_2a6.en: Look, I have no time for…

st_themaster_2a7.en: But you do have time. You have 30 seconds… to hit me. Now!
st_themaster_2a7.zh: 你有时间的。给你30秒……攻击我。现在！

st_themaster_2b2.en: Master. I see that you have met Bruce.
st_themaster_2b2.zh: 师父，你已经见过李小龙了。

st_themaster_2b3.en: He is as you said. But he could be much more.
st_themaster_2b3.zh: 正如你所说。但他潜力无穷。

st_themaster_2b4.en: I know. He has fire in his heart. But… can he contain it?
st_themaster_2b4.zh: 我知道。他内心充满激情，但……他能控制自己吗？

st_themaster_2b5.en: I believe he can. He has true potential.
st_themaster_2b5.zh: 我觉得他行。他的确潜力无穷。

st_themaster_2b6.en: I am here. Don't ignore me!

st_themaster_2b8.en: So, am I in or not?

st_themaster_2b9.en: You were in the minute you came here. Welcome.
st_themaster_2b9.zh: 踏进这个门的时候你已经属于这里了。欢迎。

st_themaster_3a1.en: Let’s spar. I will teach you to counter.
st_themaster_3a1.zh: 不用多说了。我会教你如何抵挡攻击。

st_themaster_3a3.en: Something like that. The goal is to read your opponent’s intentions before his body moves.
st_themaster_3a3.zh: 差不多吧。目标就是，在对手做出动作之前，看出他的意图。

st_themaster_3b1.en: See? Use your opponent’s force against him.
st_themaster_3b1.zh: 看到没？用对手的力量攻击对手。

st_themaster_3b2.en: I prefer just to knock him down with my first blow.
st_themaster_3b2.zh: 我更喜欢一拳就把对方击倒。

st_themaster_4a3.en: But you need to learn to control your Chi.

st_themaster_4a5.en: The fire inside of you. If you don’t learn to control it and use it to your advantage, it will devour you. Now, relax and focus yourself.
st_themaster_4a5.zh: 就是你内心的火焰。如果无法控制气并将其作为你的优势，你就会被气吞噬。现在放松一下，集中注意力。

st_themaster_4b1.en: Very good. Focus your inner fire and release it on your opponents.
st_themaster_4b1.zh: 很好。聚集你内在的火焰，向你的对手释放出来。

st_themaster_5a2.en: Yes. We have a tournament for the kung fu schools coming soon.
st_themaster_5a2.zh: 是的，有个功夫门派的比武大赛就要开始了。

st_themaster_5a4.en: Just remember: flow with your rival and focus when you need to strike.
st_themaster_5a4.zh: 记住，随对手的招式变化，攻击时集中精力。

st_themaster_5a5.en: Thank you, Master. You will not regret this.
st_themaster_5a5.zh: 谢谢，师父。你不会后悔的。

st_themaster_5b1.en: "Bruce Lee from the Dragon Warrior school versus Lo Ming of the Burning Tiger school. Three Rounds!"
st_themaster_5b1.zh: “龙战士门派的李小龙对战火焰虎门派的罗明。三局。”

st_themaster_5b2.en: So you are a Burning Tiger?

st_themaster_5b3.en: Yes. I will make you burn!
st_themaster_5b3.zh: 是的，我会把你烧成灰烬！

st_themaster_5c2.en: I will crush you, little rat.
st_themaster_5c2.zh: 我会彻底消灭你，死老鼠。

st_themaster_5c3.zh: 这只老鼠真是动作敏捷！

st_themaster_5d1.en: "Round Two goes again to Bruce Lee. Only a knockout can save Lo Ming now."
st_themaster_5d1.zh: “第二局，李小龙再次获胜。现在只有一击出局才能挽救罗明了。”

st_themaster_5d2.en: Which one of us is going to burn? I forget!
st_themaster_5d2.zh: 我们当中谁会被烧成灰烬呢？我都忘了？

st_themaster_5e1.en: "A flawless victory for the Dragon Warrior school! Bruce Lee will face the Champion in the Finals!"
st_themaster_5e1.zh: “龙战士门派完胜！李小龙将在决赛对战冠军！”

st_themaster_6a1.en: "Final combat: Bruce Lee from the Dragon Warrior school versus the Champion, Sin Fu, of the Burning Tiger school. Three Rounds."
st_themaster_6a1.zh: “最后格斗：龙战士门派的李小龙对战火焰虎门派的冠军秦福。三局。”

st_themaster_6a2.en: Another one of the Burning Tigers? I thought I put your fire out already.
st_themaster_6a2.zh: 又来一个火焰虎门派的？我还以为你们的火已经灭了。

st_themaster_6a3.en: You dare to mock us? I will teach you about respect.
st_themaster_6a3.zh: 你敢嘲笑我们？我会教你怎么尊重我们。

st_themaster_6b2.en: I see you know how to fight…

st_themaster_6b4.en: You have spirit, boy. But I shall have to destroy you!
st_themaster_6b4.zh: 小子，你挺有悟性。但我一定会消灭你！

st_themaster_6c1.en: "Round Two goes to Bruce Lee! Is it possible that we could have a new champion?"
st_themaster_6c1.zh: “第二局李小龙获胜！难道新冠军要诞生了？”

st_themaster_6c2.en: Never! I am the one and only champion.
st_themaster_6c2.zh: 不可能！我是唯一的冠军。

st_themaster_6c3.en: Things change. Let me show you how.
st_themaster_6c3.zh: 时代不一样了。我帮你认清现实。

st_themaster_6d1.en: "KO! The champion is down. We have a new kung fu school champion, Bruce Lee of the Dragon Warrior school!"
st_themaster_6d1.zh: “一击出局！冠军倒下了。新的功夫冠军诞生了，龙战士门派的李小龙！”

St_BurningTiger_1a1.en: We received a challenge from the Burning Tigers.

St_BurningTiger_1a3.en: It is not that simple. This is an unsanctioned challenge.
St_BurningTiger_1a3.zh: 没那么简单。这可是没得到批准的挑战。

St_BurningTiger_1a5.en: Yes. We can’t tell the Master. He doesn't approve of them.
St_BurningTiger_1a5.zh: 是的。我们不能告诉师父。他不会同意。

St_BurningTiger_1a8.en: I didn’t think you would show up. So, champion, are you ready for the real thing?
St_BurningTiger_1a8.zh: 我还以为你不会出现了。冠军，准备好真正比试一下了吗？

St_BurningTiger_1a12.en: Come on, let him fight. I could use some sparring.
St_BurningTiger_1a12.zh: 来吧，让他参战。我会手下留情的。

St_BurningTiger_1a13.en: Three rounds then. Do you want to place any bets, Shen Lo?
St_BurningTiger_1a13.zh: 那就打三局。沈龙，想赌点什么吗？

St_BurningTiger_1b1.en: You should calm down, Lo Ming.

St_BurningTiger_1b2.en: Shut up! The honor of the Burning Tiger school must be repaired.
St_BurningTiger_1b2.zh: 闭嘴！我们要挽回火焰虎门派的名誉。

St_BurningTiger_1c1.en: Let’s stop this. Clearly your boy is out of his mind.
St_BurningTiger_1c1.zh: 停一下。他显然失去理智了。

St_BurningTiger_1c2.en: Lo Ming, you are losing your focus. Concentrate!
St_BurningTiger_1c2.zh: 罗明，你注意力不够集中。快集中精力！

St_BurningTiger_1d2.en: What do they teach you at the Burning Tiger school?
St_BurningTiger_1d2.zh: 火焰虎门派都教了你什么？

St_BurningTiger_1d3.en: Believe me, Bruce. This has not ended yet.
St_BurningTiger_1d3.zh: 相信我，李小龙。事情还没结束。

St_BurningTiger_2a1.en: Shen Lo, I think we have a problem.
St_BurningTiger_2a1.zh: 沈龙，我们可能遇到问题了。

St_BurningTiger_2a3.en: I saw the Burning Tiger School Sifu talking with our master this morning.
St_BurningTiger_2a3.zh: 今天早上我看到火焰虎门派的辛福和我们的师父谈话。

St_BurningTiger_2a4.en: Do you think he came to complain about last night’s fight?
St_BurningTiger_2a4.zh: 你觉得他是因为昨晚的事来告状吗？

St_BurningTiger_2a5.en: We'll find out soon. Let’s get started with our training.
St_BurningTiger_2a5.zh: 很快就知道怎么回事了。我们开始训练吧。

St_BurningTiger_2b2.en: It seems that 2 of my students got into a fight against a rival school. How did this happen?
St_BurningTiger_2b2.zh: 好像我有两个徒弟昨晚与其它门派比武了。怎么回事？

St_BurningTiger_2b3.en: We were challenged, Master. Our duty was…
St_BurningTiger_2b3.zh: 师父，是他们向我们挑战。我们必须……

St_BurningTiger_2b4.en: Your duty was to ignore them… I challenge you now… What will you do, Bruce?
St_BurningTiger_2b4.zh: 你们应该置之不理……我现在挑战你……李小龙，你该怎么办？

St_BurningTiger_2c1.en: Your duty ended in the tournament. Challengers have something unsettled in their hearts. You should not encourage them!
St_BurningTiger_2c1.zh: 比武大赛结束后你就该偃旗息鼓。挑战者内心不悦。你不该鼓励他们！

St_BurningTiger_2c3.en: Sorry, not sorry… You are young and reckless; you will make the same mistakes again. Let's hope you learn something from them.
St_BurningTiger_2c3.zh: 抱歉，不要抱歉……你年轻鲁莽；你还会再犯错误。希望你吸取教训。

St_BurningTiger_3a1.en: Shen, I got this note from Sin Fu.

St_BurningTiger_3a2.en: He wants to fight you? Alone?

St_BurningTiger_3a4.en: You can’t go. Remember what the master said. I heard he has connections with the triads. He is dangerous.
St_BurningTiger_3a4.zh: 你不能去。别忘了师父说的话。我听说他和三合会有瓜葛。他很危险。

St_BurningTiger_3a5.en: So am I. But I'll try to talk with him. I owe that to the master.
St_BurningTiger_3a5.zh: 我也一样。我会尝试说服他。我答应过师父。

St_BurningTiger_3a8.en: You know what I want. Revenge.
St_BurningTiger_3a8.zh: 你知道我要干什么。复仇。

St_BurningTiger_3a9.en: Of course you do. Is Lo Ming ok?

St_BurningTiger_3a10.en: This is not about Lo Ming. This is about you and me.
St_BurningTiger_3a10.zh: 这跟罗明没关系。这是我们两个之间的事。

St_BurningTiger_3a11.en: You are not my enemy. I don't want to fight you.
St_BurningTiger_3a11.zh: 你不是我的敌人。我不想和你比武。

St_BurningTiger_3a12.en: But you are indeed my enemy. Defend yourself!
St_BurningTiger_3a12.zh: 你的确是我的敌人。好好防守吧！

St_BurningTiger_3b1.en: Do you really want to continue?

St_BurningTiger_3b2.en: You are good, but I am not done yet. Burning Tiger!
St_BurningTiger_3b2.zh: 你武功高强，但我的招式还没使完呢，火焰虎！

St_BurningTiger_3c1.en: Impossible. Who taught you to move like this? You are fast as a snake!
St_BurningTiger_3c1.zh: 不可能。谁教你这样移动？你的动作像蛇一样快！

St_BurningTiger_3c2.en: My brother taught me some useful fencing tricks.
St_BurningTiger_3c2.zh: 我师兄教我的防御技巧。

St_BurningTiger_3c5.en: I will find other ways for my revenge. Watch your back.
St_BurningTiger_3c5.zh: 我会用其它办法报仇的。你小心点。

St_CriminalBrothers_1b2.en: Here is your purse, miss. Are you all right?
St_CriminalBrothers_1b2.zh: 小姐，这是你的钱包。你还好吗？

St_CriminalBrothers_1b3.en: Yes. Thank you. That was… impressive!
St_CriminalBrothers_1b3.zh: 是的，谢谢你啊。你简直太厉害了！

St_CriminalBrothers_1b4.en: No worries. My name is Bruce.

St_CriminalBrothers_1b5.en: Mine is Yue… I saw you dancing at the club yesterday. You dance well too!
St_CriminalBrothers_1b5.zh: 我是小月……我昨晚看到你在俱乐部跳舞。你跳舞也很好啊！

St_CriminalBrothers_1b6.en: Thanks! Do you want me to escort you home?
St_CriminalBrothers_1b6.zh: 谢谢！需要我送你回家吗？

St_CriminalBrothers_1b7.en: No need. I live upstairs. But thank you again… Bruce.
St_CriminalBrothers_1b7.zh: 不用了，我就住楼上。很感谢你，李小龙。

St_CriminalBrothers_2a3.en: So, umm, how are you doing?

St_CriminalBrothers_2a5.en: Good. Good. So you like dancing too?

St_CriminalBrothers_2a7.en: I would like to dance with you.

St_CriminalBrothers_2a8.en: Are you asking me out? You don't waste any time…
St_CriminalBrothers_2a8.zh: 你在约我吗？别浪费时间了……

St_CriminalBrothers_2a9.en: That’s sweet. Two young lovers hitting it off. Well, I hate love stories.
St_CriminalBrothers_2a9.zh: 真甜蜜啊。两个人你亲我爱。我痛恨爱情故事。

St_CriminalBrothers_2a10.en: You again? You didn’t get enough last time?

St_CriminalBrothers_2a11.en: I would like to introduce you to my friend, Johnson!
St_CriminalBrothers_2a11.zh: 介绍你认识我朋友，强森！

St_CriminalBrothers_2b1.en: Get out of here! Don’t let me see you two again!
St_CriminalBrothers_2b1.zh: 滚出去！别让我再看见你！

St_CriminalBrothers_2b2.en: You will pay for this. You both will pay!
St_CriminalBrothers_2b2.zh: 你会付出代价的。你们两个一起。

St_CriminalBrothers_2b4.en: Be careful with them. They are criminals.

St_CriminalBrothers_2b5.en: Don’t worry. I can beat goons like them any time.
St_CriminalBrothers_2b5.zh: 别担心。我随时能把他们打得屁滚尿流。

St_CriminalBrothers_2b8.en: This way, I know a good dancing club near here.
St_CriminalBrothers_2b8.zh: 这边走，我知道附近有个很棒的跳舞俱乐部。

St_CriminalBrothers_3a1.en: Bruce, someone left a message for you this morning.
St_CriminalBrothers_3a1.zh: 李小龙，今天早上有人给你留了信。

St_CriminalBrothers_3a2.en: I warned you, punk. Meet us at the harbor if you care about your girl.   -Smallboy.
St_CriminalBrothers_3a2.zh: 我警告你，混小子。如果你在乎女朋友的话，到港口来找我们。

St_CriminalBrothers_3a5.en: Wait outside, punk. The boss will come when he is ready.
St_CriminalBrothers_3a5.zh: 在外面等着，混小子。老大一会儿就到。

St_CriminalBrothers_3a6.en: And I will be ready for him!

St_CriminalBrothers_3b1.en: Ah, you have come crashing in like a bull. How predictable!
St_CriminalBrothers_3b1.zh: 哦，你像头蛮牛一样冲进来。真是不出所料！

St_CriminalBrothers_3b2.en: Who are you? Where's the girl?!
St_CriminalBrothers_3b2.zh: 你是谁？那个女孩在哪里？

St_CriminalBrothers_3b3.en: You have beaten 2 of my subordinates, one of which was my brother. The way I see it you owe us money and respect. You seem too arrogant to pay respect to anyone, but I think I can make money with you.
St_CriminalBrothers_3b3.zh: 我两个手下都被你打了，其中一个还是我的哥哥。你得赔钱并尊重我们。你太自大了，不会尊重我们，但你能帮我赚钱。

St_CriminalBrothers_3b5.en: We will be organizing a little brawl here; lots of high stakes involved. You will fight against whoever we find for you and you will win. Once we get our money, the girl is yours.
St_CriminalBrothers_3b5.zh: 我们在这组织一次比武，赌注很高。我们让你和谁打，你就和谁打，必须获胜。我们拿到钱，你就把女孩带走。

St_CriminalBrothers_3b7.en: Lock him up in the cold storage room, brother. That will cool down his temper.
St_CriminalBrothers_3b7.zh: 把他锁在冷藏室，兄弟。那里能让他冷静下来。

St_CriminalBrothers_4a1.en: Welcome all! Tonight we have a special treat for you. A tournament to the death! Our challenger is Bruce "The Dragon" Lee! He will be fighting head to head with three of the most ruthless fighters in Hong Kong. Place your bets!
St_CriminalBrothers_4a1.zh: 欢迎大家！今晚给大家准备了特别的项目－死亡比武！挑战者是“龙战士”李小龙！他会与香港三个最冷酷无情的武师决斗。下注吧！

St_CriminalBrothers_4a2.en: First, Lo Ming from the notorious Burning Tiger kung fu school. He has a bone to pick with our guest!
St_CriminalBrothers_4a2.zh: 第一个对手是火焰虎功夫门派的罗明。他会给李小龙好看的！

St_CriminalBrothers_4a3.en: I will crush you this time, rat!
St_CriminalBrothers_4a3.zh: 我这次要弄死你，死老鼠！

St_CriminalBrothers_4a4.en: You talk and talk. Talking won't stop me!
St_CriminalBrothers_4a4.zh: 你就耍嘴皮子吧。嘴皮子打不倒我！

St_CriminalBrothers_4b1.en: Bruce is still standing! The next fighter is one of our finest! It is said that voodoo priests in New Orleans cursed him to beat the hell out of every living thing! He is… Johnson!!
St_CriminalBrothers_4b1.zh: 李小龙获胜了！下一个对手武功十分高强！据说新奥尔良的巫毒大师给他下了咒，让他把死亡带给每个对手！他就是……强森！

St_CriminalBrothers_4b2.zh: 我不是已经打倒你了吗？

St_CriminalBrothers_4b3.en: We sparred. This time it’s for real. These brass knuckles will make short work of you!
St_CriminalBrothers_4b3.zh: 上次只是动嘴，这次可是真格的。我的指节铜环会让你好看！

St_CriminalBrothers_4c1.en: Is he dead? Somebody get Johnson a doctor!
St_CriminalBrothers_4c1.zh: 他死了吗？快把强森送去医院！

St_CriminalBrothers_4c2.en: What a fight! But now we have a special contender for our guest, a renowned international fighter: Ken Goodall!
St_CriminalBrothers_4c2.zh: 真是太精彩了！请我们的特别嘉宾出场，全球著名的武师：康古道！

St_CriminalBrothers_4c3.en: Nice to meet you, Bruce. I must apologize in advance… for kicking your ass!
St_CriminalBrothers_4c3.zh: 很高兴见到你，李小龙。提前道个歉……因为我会好好教训一下你！

St_CriminalBrothers_4d1.en: Is that all!? Where is Yue?

St_CriminalBrothers_4d2.en: One more fight to go, my friend. I hope you like surprises.
St_CriminalBrothers_4d2.zh: 还有一场，朋友。希望你喜欢惊喜。

St_CriminalBrothers_4d3.en: Place your final bets! The master of Kung Fu! The ferocious Shen Lo!
St_CriminalBrothers_4d3.zh: 最后一次下注！功夫大师出场！无敌的沈龙！

St_CriminalBrothers_4d6.en: What the hell are you doing here?

St_CriminalBrothers_4d7.en: I owe them money. A lot of money.

St_CriminalBrothers_4d9.en: Gambling. They will forgive the debt if I beat you. I´m sorry, Bruce.
St_CriminalBrothers_4d9.zh: 赌博。如果我击败你，赌债就一笔勾销。抱歉，李小龙。

St_CriminalBrothers_4d11.en: Enough talk! Once friends! Now enemies! Place your bets! Fight!
St_CriminalBrothers_4d11.zh: 少废话了！以前是朋友，现在是仇敌！下注！开打！

St_CriminalBrothers_4e3.en: Enough! It’s over, brother. I see that no one here is up to the task of bringing down this man. As with everything else, I'll have to do it myself.
St_CriminalBrothers_4e3.zh: 够了！结束了，兄弟。我看这没人能把这家伙打倒。我还是亲自动手吧。

St_CriminalBrothers_4e5.en: No, you can’t. Now, bring the girl here. If he wins, let her go. If I win, break her neck and make him watch!
St_CriminalBrothers_4e5.zh: 你不行。把女孩带过来。如果他赢了，就放女孩走。如果我赢了，就扭断她的脖子给李小龙看！

St_CriminalBrothers_4f1.en: You did it, Bruce!! We better get going. These people are starting to give me the shivers…
St_CriminalBrothers_4f1.zh: 你赢了，李小龙！！我们快走吧。这些人让我害怕……

St_CriminalBrothers_4f5.en: They threatened my mother! And they could have killed me!
St_CriminalBrothers_4f5.zh: 他们威胁我妈妈！他们可能杀了我！

St_CriminalBrothers_4f7.en: Is this how it will be with you, Bruce? Always living in fear?!
St_CriminalBrothers_4f7.zh: 和你一起的将来会是这样吗，李小龙？一直生活在恐惧中？！

St_CriminalBrothers_4f9.en: I never want to see you again! You hear?! If I see you, I will call the police!
St_CriminalBrothers_4f9.zh: 我再也不想见到你了！你听到没？！我再见到你就报警！

St_CriminalBrothers_4f10.en: A simple "thank you" would have been fine.

St_TheTournament_1a3.en: I'm sorry… I could not know that…

St_TheTournament_1a4.en: I hope you are fully recovered from the fight. I need a sparring partner.
St_TheTournament_1a4.zh: 我希望你完全恢复了。我需要个搏击伙伴。

St_TheTournament_1b1.en: Will the prize from the International tournament cover your debt?
St_TheTournament_1b1.zh: 国际比武大赛的奖金能还上你的债吗？

St_TheTournament_1b2.en: What?…er, yes. The prizes are big.
St_TheTournament_1b2.zh: 什么？……可以的。奖金很丰厚。

St_TheTournament_1b3.en: But I will need money for the entry fee.

St_TheTournament_1b4.en: I may know a way. There’s another illegal fight at the harbor before the tournament, with a lot of gambling. I'll bet on you, Bruce!. We can't lose!
St_TheTournament_1b4.zh: 我知道个办法。比武大赛前，在港口还有一次非法格斗，赌注很大。我赌你赢，李小龙！我们绝不能输！

St_TheTournament_1b5.en: You should start being more careful with that gambling problem…
St_TheTournament_1b5.zh: 你现在应该想想怎么克服好赌的问题了……

St_TheTournament_2a1.en: Place your bets, gentlemen! Today's fight is between Bruce Lee and Ken Goodall Junior!
St_TheTournament_2a1.zh: 先生们，下注吧！今天是李小龙与康古道二世的决斗！

St_TheTournament_2a3.en: Sorry if I hit you too hard last week. I was in a hurry.
St_TheTournament_2a3.zh: 抱歉，上周把你打惨了。我赶时间。

St_TheTournament_2a4.en: Well, I had a good headache after the fight.
St_TheTournament_2a4.zh: 比武后我可是头痛了好长时间。

St_TheTournament_2a6.en: No worries, I always give back more than I take.

St_TheTournament_2b1.en: You are fast as a snake!

St_TheTournament_2b3.en: You should come to the USA! You would be famous.
St_TheTournament_2b3.zh: 你应该到美国来！你会出名的。

St_TheTournament_2b4.en: I don't know what to say…

St_TheTournament_2b5.en: Then say nothing and keep fighting, pal!
St_TheTournament_2b5.zh: 那就什么也不说，打吧，伙计！

St_TheTournament_2c1.en: We have a challenge! Bets are that Bruce Lee will knock Ken out in 30 seconds! Place your bets!
St_TheTournament_2c1.zh: 比武开始！赌李小龙在30秒内打倒康古道！下注吧！

St_TheTournament_2c3.en: Shen Lo. Put all the money on this bet! Trust me!
St_TheTournament_2c3.zh: 沈龙。把钱都赌上！相信我！

St_TheTournament_2c4.en: I trust you. Good luck to us both.
St_TheTournament_2c4.zh: 我相信你，祝我们两个好运。

St_TheTournament_2d1.zh: 难以置信！30 秒内一击出局！

St_TheTournament_2d3.en: Sorry, friend. I hope we meet again on better terms.
St_TheTournament_2d3.zh: 抱歉，朋友。我希望下次见面不在这里。

St_TheTournament_2d4.en: I have the money, Bruce! Let's go.
St_TheTournament_2d4.zh: 我有钱了，李小龙！我们走。

St_TheTournament_3a2.en: In the semifinals we have Bruce Lee from the Dragon Warrior school against Ken Goodall Junior, the son of the boxing legend Ken Goodall Senior.
St_TheTournament_3a2.zh: 龙战士门派的李小龙在半决赛中击败传奇格斗大师康古道一世之子康古道二世。

St_TheTournament_3a4.en: Why am I always fighting you?
St_TheTournament_3a4.zh: 为什么总是我们两个比武？

St_TheTournament_3a5.en: I have to pay the bills, man!. This time you won’t take me by surprise.
St_TheTournament_3a5.zh: 我得过活啊，伙计！这次你的偷袭无法得手了。

St_TheTournament_3a6.en: Ah, you mean our last fight? Sorry, I was in a hurry again.
St_TheTournament_3a6.zh: 你是说上次？不好意思，我赶时间。

St_TheTournament_3a7.en: You should stop running, Bruce. You'll get hurt.
St_TheTournament_3a7.zh: 别再跑了，李小龙。你会受伤的。

St_TheTournament_3b1.en: Round One goes to Bruce Lee!

St_TheTournament_3b4.en: Come on. You can do it. Two more rounds. Then you can rest.
St_TheTournament_3b4.zh: 来吧，你可以的。还有两局。然后你就能休息了。

St_TheTournament_3c1.en: Again. Round Two goes to Bruce Lee!
St_TheTournament_3c1.zh: 第二局李小龙再次获胜！

St_TheTournament_3c2.en: All warmed up and ready for the champ. I’ll knock you out now.
St_TheTournament_3c2.zh: 热身好了，我准备拿冠军了。我现在就让你出局。

St_TheTournament_3c3.en: Man, I'm starting to think you enjoy this.
St_TheTournament_3c3.zh: 伙计，我觉得你开始享受了。

St_TheTournament_3c4.en: It's the only way, friend It's the only way.
St_TheTournament_3c4.zh: 这是唯一的办法，朋友，唯一的办法。

St_TheTournament_3d1.en: And the winner is Bruce Lee. An incredible fight! He will go to the finals to fight Brick Davis!
St_TheTournament_3d1.zh: 获胜者是李小龙。令人难以置信！他将在决赛中与铁骨戴维斯一较高下！

St_TheTournament_4a1.en: Welcome, everybody, to the final fight of the International Fighting Championship in Hong Kong!
St_TheTournament_4a1.zh: 欢迎大家观看香港国际比武冠军赛的决赛！

St_TheTournament_4a2.en: We have a great match lined up for you, Bruce Lee from Hong Kong versus the champion, Brick Davis from the USA.
St_TheTournament_4a2.zh: 精彩赛事正等着你，香港的李小龙对战美国冠军铁骨戴维斯。

St_TheTournament_4a3.en: That man is like a stone wall!

St_TheTournament_4a4.en: I will knock you out, little man. Your kung fu is no match for my fists!
St_TheTournament_4a4.zh: 我会打倒你的，小个子。你的功夫无法战胜我的拳头！

St_TheTournament_4b1.en: Bruce Lee wins the first round!

St_TheTournament_4b2.zh: 你说的一击出局在哪里呢？

St_TheTournament_4b3.en: It will come. I promise you. It will come.
St_TheTournament_4b3.zh: 会来的。我保证。一定会来的。

St_TheTournament_4c1.en: Brick Davis is in trouble. Two losses in a row.
St_TheTournament_4c1.zh: 铁骨戴维斯遇到麻烦了。连失两局！

St_TheTournament_4c2.en: Well, you are really annoying me. And when I’m annoyed, people get out of my way!
St_TheTournament_4c2.zh: 你惹恼我了。我发怒后谁也逃不掉！

St_TheTournament_4c3.en: I’m not going anywhere but you don’t look annoyed to me. You look like a man who just took a beating.
St_TheTournament_4c3.zh: 我哪里也不去，我一点也不生气。你只有挨打的份。

St_TheTournament_4c4.en: Enough talk! This is it! Time to kiss the floor, little man.
St_TheTournament_4c4.zh: 够了！开始吧！你就要倒下了，小个子。

St_TheTournament_4c5.en: Yes, yes. Time for a nap, big man!
St_TheTournament_4c5.zh: 是啊，该休息一下了，大块头！

St_TheTournament_4d1.en: Knock out!!! Bruce Lee wins the International Fighting Championship!
St_TheTournament_4d1.zh: 一击出局！李小龙获得国际比武大赛冠军！

St_TheTournament_4d3.en: I did it. But no more gambling!

St_TheTournament_4d4.en: I don't know what to say… thanks.
St_TheTournament_4d4.zh: 我不知道说什么好……谢谢。

St_TheTournament_4d6.en: Let's celebrate it! You are the best, Bruce!!
St_TheTournament_4d6.zh: 一起庆祝一下吧！李小龙，你是最棒的！

St_Changes_1a1.en: Welcome, Bruce. I thought we should pay a visit to my very notable opponents.
St_Changes_1a1.zh: 欢迎，李小龙。我有几个很厉害的对手，我们应该一起看看他们。

St_Changes_1a2.en: You sick bastard! If you have injured them…
St_Changes_1a2.zh: 你这个混蛋！如果你敢伤害他们……

St_Changes_1a3.en: My friends have only roughed them up, though some may have gotten carried away.
St_Changes_1a3.zh: 我的朋友只是揍了他们一顿，有些人可能被抬走了。

St_Changes_1a4.en: Look out, Bruce! They have poison on their knuckles!
St_Changes_1a4.zh: 李小龙，小心！他们的勾爪上有毒！

St_Changes_1a5.en: Shut up or we’ll finish you!

St_Changes_1a6.en: Oh, now you’ve spoiled the surprise. That’s no fun.
St_Changes_1a6.zh: 唉，你把惊喜都毁了，一点也不好玩。

St_Changes_1b2.en: Now it's my turn. I will finish you, rat!
St_Changes_1b2.zh: 轮到我了。我要弄死你，死老鼠！

St_Changes_1c1.en: I wonder why do I hire lowlifes like you? Consider yourselves fired.
St_Changes_1c1.zh: 我不明白怎么雇了你们这帮人渣？滚蛋吧。

St_Changes_1c2.en: They are worth only as much as their employer.
St_Changes_1c2.zh: 他们跟雇主是一路货色。

St_Changes_1c3.en: Enough talking. You won't come out of this alive.
St_Changes_1c3.zh: 够了。你不可能活着出去。

St_Changes_1d1.en: Useless. Useless goons! In the end it's just you and me.
St_Changes_1d1.zh: 没用。没用的笨蛋！最后还是我们两个决斗。

St_Changes_1d2.en: You… should… run away like… them, maggot.
St_Changes_1d2.zh: 你应该跟他们一样逃走，人渣。

St_Changes_1d3.en: Will you please shut up and die?

St_Changes_1e1.en: It’s over, Bruce. Let the rage fade away. We are okay.
St_Changes_1e1.zh: 一切都结束了，李小龙。做个了结吧。我们和好。

St_Changes_1e3.en: He's only bruised. And there is no major damage to the temple. It can be rebuilt, just as your wounds will heal.
St_Changes_1e3.zh: 他只是受了轻伤。寺庙的损坏也不严重，可以重建，就像伤口能愈合。

St_Changes_2a2.en: Bruce, are you fully recovered? You came to help?
St_Changes_2a2.zh: 李小龙，你恢复了吗？你来帮忙？

St_Changes_2a3.en: No, I came to tell you I am leaving.
St_Changes_2a3.zh: 不，我是来告诉你我要离开。

St_Changes_2a5.en: Hong Kong is not safe for me or anyone around me. Sooner or later someone will get hurt.
St_Changes_2a5.zh: 香港对我或身边的人不再安全。早晚会有人受伤。

St_Changes_2a9.en: I was born there. They have to let me in.
St_Changes_2a9.zh: 我在那里出生。我能回去的。

St_Changes_2a10.en: What will you do there? You can’t live like this, fighting in the streets, making trouble. As you have seen, there are always consequences.
St_Changes_2a10.zh: 你到美国干什么？你不能这样生活，在街上打打杀杀，到处惹麻烦。你也知道，做事肯定有后果的。

St_Changes_2a11.en: I see it now. No matter how well I fight, there will always be people that won't stop for anything.
St_Changes_2a11.zh: 我现在明白了。无论我武功多么高强，总会有人不停来找麻烦。

St_Changes_2a12.en: There is an old saying: The oak tree is mighty, yet it can be destroyed by a mighty wind because it resists; the bamboo, however, bends with the wind, and by bending, survives.
St_Changes_2a12.zh: 常言道：橡树虽然强韧，但因为他和风对抗，还是会被吹倒；竹子随风弯曲，弯曲让竹子生存下来。

St_Changes_2a14.en: Don't be sorry. You have much to learn, but also much to offer to the world. Calm your spirit and be one with your path. I have faith in you, my boy.
St_Changes_2a14.zh: 不用道歉。你还有很多东西要学，还能做很多有意义的事情。冷静下来，想好自己的路。我对你有信心，孩子。

St_Changes_2a15.en: I will be back, Master. Hopefully as a better man.
St_Changes_2a15.zh: 师父，我会回来的。希望到时能有所长进。
